name: FTB-Skies-2-Aero
description: Dedicated server for the FTB Skies 2: Aero modpack (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge, Java 21), a skyblock pack built around airships. On the first start the container installs the modpack into the appdata folder with the official FTB server installer (about 1.3 GB, takes a few minutes); after that the server starts right away. Set EULA to true to accept the Minecraft EULA. Ops, MOTD, world name and Java memory are set through the variables. To update the modpack, change FTB_VERSION_ID to the ID shown on the FTB versions page.

variables.name: EULA
variables.description: Do you agree to the Mojang EULA available at https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula? Server will not start without accepting. Set to 'true' to accept.

variables.name: OPS
variables.description: Comma separated list of players to have op capability

variables.name: LEVEL
variables.description: Name of the world directory. It is usually world.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the server files

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the server files

variables.name: FTB_VERSION_ID
variables.description: FTB modpack version ID (100527 = 1.13.0). Change it to update the modpack on the next start.
